title: Prepare input crystal structures
action: Retrieve the experimental crystal structures of Sr2NiIrO6 and Sr2ZnIrO6 (monoclinic P2_1/n) from the published neutron diffraction data (Kayser et al. 2013) and generate DFT-format input files.
description: The structures must be converted into coordinates and lattice parameters suitable for the chosen DFT code. This step records the retrieved geometry.
output_schema: Lattice parameters, atomic species, and fractional coordinates of the two compounds

title: Construct artificial structural models
action: Build substitutional and supercell models to isolate magnetic sublattices and reduce Ir coordination: (a) Sr2Zn(Ni)IrO6 by replacing Ni with Zn in Sr2NiIrO6; (b) La2NiSiO6 by replacing Sr with La and Ir with Si; (c) Sr2GaIr0.5Si0.5O6 with alternating GaIr and SiGa planes for four-coordinated Ir.
description: The three artificial structures are needed to extract individual exchange coupling contributions and to test the effect of reduced coordination on SOC. The rationale and unit-cell descriptions are recorded.
output_schema: Text description of the substitution method, lattice parameters, and atomic positions

title: LSDA electronic structure calculation
action: Perform a self-consistent spin-polarized LSDA calculation for FM Sr2NiIrO6 and extract the Ir 5d t2g bandwidth and the exchange splitting between spin channels.
description: The LSDA run confirms the Ni2+/Ir6+ charge state and provides the Ir t2g bandwidth and exchange splitting that determine whether SOC is quenched.

title: LSDA+U total energy calculations for multiple magnetic configurations
action: Perform LSDA+U calculations (U_Ni=6 eV, J_Ni=0.9 eV; U_Ir=2 eV, J_Ir=0.4 eV) for all four systems (Sr2NiIrO6, Sr2Zn(Ni)IrO6, La2NiSiO6, real Sr2ZnIrO6) in the FM, G-AF, layered AF, and bilayered AF collinear magnetic states. Converge total energies to meV accuracy.
description: A consistent set of LSDA+U runs that provides the raw total energies from which exchange parameters are derived. All systems and states must be computed with the same k-mesh and energy cutoffs.
output_schema: Tabulated total energy per formula unit (eV) for each system/magnetic state, recorded from the DFT output

title: Output total energies table
action: Compile the converged LSDA+U total energies (per formula unit) from the previous step into a CSV file.
description: Table recording the total energy (eV) for each system (Sr2NiIrO6, Sr2Zn(Ni)IrO6, La2NiSiO6, Sr2ZnIrO6) and each magnetic state (FM, G_AF, layered_AF, bilayered_AF). The checker recomputes exchange parameters from these energy differences.
output_schema: columns: system (string), magnetic_state (string: FM, G_AF, layered_AF, bilayered_AF), total_energy_ev (float)

title: LDA+SOC calculation and J-projected DOS analysis
action: Perform LDA+SOC calculations for real Sr2ZnIrO6 and the artificial low-coordination model Sr2GaIr0.5Si0.5O6. Project the Ir t2g density of states onto the |J=3/2> and |J=1/2> basis and report the mixing and SOC splitting.
description: Demonstrates that J=3/2 and J=1/2 states are strongly mixed for high-coordination fcc Ir, but a ~0.5 eV SOC splitting is restored when coordination is reduced to four. This step provides qualitative evidence but is not directly scored.

title: LSDA+U+SOC calculation and Ir orbital moment
action: Perform a self-consistent LSDA+U+SOC calculation for Sr2NiIrO6 and extract the Ir orbital magnetic moment.
description: Report the Ir orbital moment (in μB) obtained including correlation and spin-orbit coupling. The checker compares this value to the hidden paper result.
